facts.text: The hotel is riverside in the Southbank precinct, a few minutes' walk from the city center.

facts.text: The hotel lobby chandelier is custom-made with Waterford crystal.

facts.text: In 2013 the hotel began a partnership with illustrator Kerrie Hess, whose art is exhibited in the hotel.
facts.excerpt: In 2013, The Langham, Melbourne began an enduring partnership with world-renowned illustrator, Kerrie Hess.

facts.text: Aria Bar & Lounge serves afternoon tea seven days a week.
facts.excerpt: Aria Bar & Lounge offers it seven days a week!

facts.text: The afternoon tea uses specialty tea from the British tea brand JING.

facts.text: The Residence by Kerrie Hess is a private apartment with a lounge and dining area, two bedrooms, two marble bathrooms and a kitchen.
facts.excerpt: This sprawling private apartment includes a spacious lounge and dining area, two bedrooms, two marble bathrooms and a modern kitchen.

facts.text: The Langham Club offers private check-ins, refreshments and a workspace for private meetings.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy private check-ins, tantalising refreshments, and an elegant workspace to host private meetings.

facts.text: Even the most modest guest rooms have marble bathrooms with generous tubs.
facts.excerpt: Even The Langham's most modest guest rooms feature marble bathrooms with generous tubs.

facts.text: Deluxe Balcony Rooms have a balcony for sunsets and cityscapes.
facts.excerpt: The Deluxe Balcony Room's balcony is perfect for enjoying sunsets and cityscapes.

facts.text: The Chuan Spa is best known for traditional Chinese massages.
facts.excerpt: The Chuan Spa is best known for its traditional Chinese massages

facts.text: Melba is the hotel's flagship restaurant and serves a grazing buffet at lunch and dinner.
facts.excerpt: The hotel's flagship restaurant, Melba, serves a enormous lunch/dinner grazing buffet

facts.text: Executive class rooms are on higher floors and give access to the Club Lounge for free breakfast, drinks and canapes.
facts.excerpt: Rooms in the Executive class are on higher floors of the 24-story property and grant guests access to the Club Lounge for free breakfast, drinks, and canapés.
